wins.text: Q3 consolidated net revenue of $13.1B, up 47% YoY; operating profit up 44% YoY
AI revenue raised to $12B for fiscal 2024, up from prior guidance of >$11B; Q4 AI revenue expected to grow 10% sequentially to >$3.5B
VMware annualized booking value (ABV) of $2.5B in Q3, up 32% QoQ; >80% of VMware bookings were for full-stack VCF product
Infrastructure software operating margin of 67% (69% ex-transition costs); VMware OpEx reduced to $1.3B in Q3 from $1.6B in Q2, on track to exceed $8.5B EBITDA target in FY25
Non-AI networking recovered 17% sequentially in Q3; non-AI semiconductor bookings up 20% in Q3 signaling broad cyclical recovery

risks.text: Broadband revenue declined 49% YoY to $557M in Q3 and expected to remain down >40% YoY in Q4; recovery not expected until 2025
Semiconductor gross margins compressed ~270 bps YoY to ~68% due to higher mix of lower-margin custom AI accelerators
Free cash flow as % of revenue declined YoY due to higher cash interest expense from VMware acquisition debt ($72.3B gross principal) and higher cash taxes from delayed Section 174 reenactment
Industrial resales declined 31% YoY to $164M in Q3; still expected down ~20% YoY in Q4
$4.5B tax liability from IP relocation back to the U.S. raised investor concern about potential asset sales or financial stress, though management characterized it as largely non-cash

guidance_items.detail: Q4 consolidated revenue guided to ~$14B (+51% YoY); FY2024 revenue outlook raised to $51.5B
Q4 adjusted EBITDA guided to ~64% of revenue; FY2024 adjusted EBITDA raised to 61.5% of revenue
AI revenue for FY2024 raised to >$12B from prior guidance of >$11B; Q4 AI revenue expected >$3.5B
Q4 semiconductor revenue ~$8B (+9% YoY); infrastructure software revenue ~$6B
Q4 quarterly cash dividend rounded up to $0.53/share from $0.525; non-GAAP diluted share count ~4.91B

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential shift in hyperscaler AI spend away from custom ASICs/XPUs back toward merchant GPUs (NVIDIA Blackwell cycle) and impact on Broadcom's AI revenue trajectory
IP relocation to U.S. creating $4.5B tax liability and whether it signals pending asset sales to pay down VMware acquisition debt
Customer concentration risk within AI accelerator revenue — degree of reliance on single largest XPU customer vs. newer customers ramping
